title: Assistant agentic multi-step loop
intent: Wire the item-3 model client, item-5 tool runtime, and item-6 transcript replay into a resumable multi-iteration assistant loop without modifying orchestrator/app wiring.
scope: Expose a service-level AssistantAgentLoop API with StartTurn, ResumeAfterAsyncObservation, and ResumeAfterActionDecision entry points for item 8 to call.
Build model input from AssistantContextBuilder.BuildModelHistory, including replayed transcript memory and the current operator prompt.
Inject provider-neutral tool schemas into AgentModelClient.Next requests without importing internal/mcp into internal/service.
Persist assistant, user, and tool observation messages through the transcript append interface so subsequent turns replay memory.
Execute model tool calls through AssistantToolRuntime and suspend on waiting_async or deferred approval observations.
Resume async observations and approval decisions by feeding normalized tool observations back to the model loop.
Bound runaway behavior with max_iterations and max_consecutive_tool_failures from AssistantAgenticConfig.
out_of_scope: Routing assistant prompts through the loop in AssistantOrchestrator or app wiring.
External MCP client or subagent/skill/hook loading.
Changing Nostr event kinds or payload shapes.
architecture_notes: AssistantAgentToolSchemaProvider is a service-local model schema interface so item 8 can adapt MCP descriptors without creating an internal/service -> internal/mcp import cycle.

Approved deferred actions are executed through AssistantToolRuntime.Execute with a narrow ApprovedAction override that validates session/run/turn/tool-call binding and preserves runtime dispatch semantics.

waiting_async and awaiting_approval observations are not fed to the model immediately; the loop persists/suspends and later feeds the terminal async observation or approve/reject decision observation.
